subject.title: Update 2026.3.24 silently drops config when HOME changes

question: When the updater HOME differs from the installed gateway service HOME and no explicit `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` is present, should OpenClaw preserve the service HOME, block until explicit migration, or add a guarded doctor migration?
rationale: The desired behavior crosses config, credential, service, and Unix-user trust boundaries, and the current code intentionally drops stale service control env for security reasons.

options.title: Block and require explicit migration
options.body: Detect the HOME mismatch, stop before config/service rewrite, and point the operator to a doctor migration that shows the source and destination roots.

options.title: Preserve installed service HOME
options.body: Carry the previous service HOME into update doctor/restart paths when the installed service can be authenticated as OpenClaw-owned.

options.title: Manual docs-only recovery
options.body: Document the wrong-HOME update class and leave automatic preservation/migration out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Block and require explicit migration
recommendation.body: Detect the HOME mismatch, stop before config/service rewrite, and point the operator to a doctor migration that shows the source and destination roots.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent central work on update restart behavior and service environment handling is in this area.
